summary.zh: 偏输出的神圣起手：10% 额外智力、更强的圣印与审判、先点治疗之光，以及施法时仍然生效的法力回复。
summary.en: A damage-leaning Holy opening: 10% more Intellect, stronger Seals and Judgements, a first step into Healing Light, and Mana regeneration that keeps running while you cast.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，既能进本治疗，也要单刷任务
scenario.en: Levels 10–20, healing dungeons while still questing solo

pros.zh: 神圣智慧提供 10% 智力，既扩大法力池，也通过装备上的法术强度提高治疗量。
pros.en: Divine Intellect adds 10% Intellect, which is both a larger Mana pool and more healing from the spell power on early gear.

pros.zh: 强化圣印让圣印与审判伤害提高 15%，在点出真正的治疗天赋之前，单刷速度不会掉下来。
pros.en: Improved Seals raises Seal and Judgement damage by 15%, so solo kills stay quick while you level toward the real healing talents.

pros.zh: 治疗之光投入 2 点，让圣光术与圣光闪现的治疗量提高 8%，进本治疗时最常用的就是这两个法术。
pros.en: Two points in Healing Light add 8% to Holy Light and Flash of Light, the heals you lean on in dungeons.

pros.zh: 敬畏让 10% 的法力回复在施法时继续生效。
pros.en: Reverence lets 10% of your Mana regeneration continue while casting.

pros.zh: 几乎只组队？把强化圣印的点数移到治疗之光和精神集中，治疗更强，施法也不易被打断推迟。
pros.en: Playing almost entirely in groups? Move the Improved Seals points into Healing Light and Spiritual Focus for stronger heals that are not pushed back.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
